Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

What NOT to do when designing a UI or page. This is a filter, not a style; it never prescribes a look. Stacking several of the below is what reads as AI-made on sight. Adaptive, so if the user or another skill asks for something specific, do that instead; these are defaults, not overrides.

- purple / indigo / violet accent, or a purple-to-blue hero gradient (the top AI tell)
- `bg-clip-text` gradient headline text
- cream (`#faf8f4`) as the whole-page background
- aurora blobs / glowing colored shadows, or an identical glow on every card

- emoji as feature icons (🚀 ⚡ ✨ 🎯 💡)

- fade-up / slide-up on everything as it scrolls in
- motion that ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #0a0604; }
  body { position: fixed; inset: 0; }
  canvas {
    display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; height: 100dvh;
    touch-action: none; cursor: pointer; outline: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen with noodles, tofu, mushrooms, bok choy and vegetables in warm light on a dark background"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const canvas = document.getElementById("scene");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, S = 1, CX = 0, CY = 0;

  // Deterministic randomness so the dish is composed, not scattered.
  let seed = 20261013;
  const rnd = () => (seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  const rr = (a, b) => a + rnd() * (b - a);
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
  const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;

  const seedsPos = [], scallions = [], oilDrops = [], embers = [], corn = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) { const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()); seedsPos.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r * .88, y: Math.sin(a) * r * .8, a: rnd() * TAU, s: rr(.7, 1.25) }); }
  for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) { const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()); scallions.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r * .9, y: Math.sin(a) * r * .82, a: rnd() * TAU, s: rr(.7, 1.3), ring: rnd() > .45 }); }
  for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) { const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()); oilDrops.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r * .92, y: Math.sin(a) * r * .85, r: rr(2, 9), p: rnd() * TAU }); }
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) corn.push({ x: rr(-.55, -.12), y: rr(.18, .62), a: rnd() * TAU, s: rr(.8, 1.2) });
  for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) embers.push({ x: rnd(), y: rnd(), r: rr(.6, 2.2), p: rnd() * TAU, v: rr(.004, .016), drift: rr(-.006, .006) });

  const mouse = { x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0, wind: 0, twind: 0, inside: false };
  const ripples = [], steam = [];
  function spawnSteam(burst) {
    const n = burst ? 10 : 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (steam.length > 130) steam.shift();
      steam.push({
        x: rr(-.62, .62), y: rr(-.18, .18), age: burst ? rr(0, .25) : 0,
        life: rr(3.2, 5.6), r: rr(10, 26), sway: rr(.5, 1.4), phase: rr(0, TAU), spin: rr(-.5, .5)
      });
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) { spawnSteam(false); steam[steam.length - 1].age = rnd() * 5; }

  function resize() {
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR); canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + "px"; canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    S = Math.min(W / 980, H / 720);            // design scale
    S = Math.max(S, Math.min(W, H) / 720);     // keep bowl large on portrait phones
    CX = W / 2; CY = H * 0.56;
    if (reduced.matches) draw(0, 0);
  }

  function ellipsePath(x, y, rx, ry, rot) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, rot || 0, 0, TAU); }
  function circle(x, y, r) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); }

  function drawBackground(t) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#070403"); g.addColorStop(.55, "#120b06"); g.addColorStop(1, "#050302");
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // Warm halo — follows the pointer a little, breathes very slowly.
    const flicker = reduced.matches ? 0 : Math.sin(t * .7) * .035 + Math.sin(t * 1.7 + 1.3) * .02;
    const gx = CX + mouse.x * 60 * S, gy = CY - 150 * S + mouse.y * 26 * S;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, 560 * S);
    rg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,166,72,${.30 + flicker})`);
    rg.addColorStop(.35, `rgba(196,88,28,${.15 + flicker * .5})`);
    rg.addColorStop(.7, "rgba(80,34,12,.05)"); rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // Table surface
    const ty = CY + 172 * S;
    const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ty - 30 * S, 0, H);
    tg.addColorStop(0, "#241409"); tg.addColorStop(.18, "#180c05"); tg.addColorStop(1, "#030201");
    ctx.fillStyle = tg; ctx.fillRect(0, ty, W, H - ty);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,170,80,.07)"; ctx.fillRect(0, ty, W, Math.max(1, 1.5 * S));
    // Drifting embers / dust in the warm light
    for (const e of embers) {
      const y = reduced.matches ? e.y : ((e.y - t * e.v) % 1 + 1) % 1;
      const x = e.x + (reduced.matches ? 0 : Math.sin(t * .3 + e.p) * .012) + mouse.x * .01;
      const a = .10 + .16 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * .9 + e.p));
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,190,110,${a})`; circle(x * W, y * H, e.r * S); ctx.fill();
    }
    // Vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, CY - 40 * S, Math.min(W, H) * .32, CX, CY, Math.max(W, H) * .78);
    vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)"); vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.72)");
    ctx.fillStyle = vg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

The single self-contained file draws everything in canvas code with zero external or embedded raster assets: a still, grounded ceramic bowl of miso broth with noodles lifted by chopsticks, tofu, shiitake, bok choy, nori, carrot, corn, chilli, scallion, and sesame. Curling steam, shimmering chilli oil, gently bobbing toppings, drifting embers, and a breathing warm glow keep it alive, while the pointer bends the steam, shifts the light and broth gloss, adds subtle parallax, and a click or tap ripples the broth with a burst of steam. It scales responsively to any screen (including portrait phones and high-DPI displays), contains no visible text or UI, and under `prefers-reduced-motion` it renders one static frame with no animation loop.
